messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to pantoprazole: hives; difficulty breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
- severe stomach pain, diarrhea that is watery or bloody;
- sudden pain or trouble moving your hip, wrist, or back;
- bruising or swelling where intravenous pantoprazole was injected;
- kidney problems - fever, rash, nausea, loss of appetite, joint pain, urinating less than usual, blood in your urine, weight gain;
- low magnesium - dizziness, fast or irregular heart rate, tremors (shaking) or jerking muscle movements, feeling jittery, muscle cramps, muscle spasms in your hands and feet, cough or choking feeling; or
- new or worsening symptoms of lupus - joint pain, and a skin rash on your cheeks or arms that worsens in sunlight.
- severe skin reactions - fever, chills, body aches, shortness of breath, enlarged lymph nodes, or a skin rash that blisters, peels, or bleeds;
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "has symptom of severe skin reactions", "body aches"]

The relation 'has symptom of severe skin reactions' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the symptom associated with severe skin reactions specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
